title: VAT Validator API - VIES Check, Company Name & Address

vatNumbers.title: VAT numbers to check
vatNumbers.description: One per line, with the country prefix: DE259137088, FR 40 303265045, NL004495445B01. Spaces, dots and dashes are ignored. Up to 4,000 per run.

text.title: Or paste a document (optional)
text.description: Used only when 'VAT numbers to check' is empty: numbers are pulled out of an invoice, an email or any pasted text, in the order they appear. A bare number without a country prefix glued to it is checked but never charged.

countryHint.title: Country prefix for bare numbers (optional)
countryHint.description: Two-letter code, used only for numbers that come without a prefix, for example a column of German numbers pasted without DE.

checkVies.title: Ask VIES (live registry, recommended)
checkVies.description: On by default. Turn it off for a pure offline run: shape and checksum only, no VIES calls, and the status says so.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache VIES answers for (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: 0 turns the cache off. A cached answer is not charged: the number is the same public record, whoever asked first.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel VIES requests
maxConcurrency.description: VIES limits simultaneous requests; 3 is safe, 8 is the ceiling here. One question takes 2 to 6 seconds, so 3 handles roughly 2,000 numbers per hour and 8 roughly 4,000 in most of an hour. Lower it if you see many UNVERIFIED rows.

timeBudgetSeconds.title: Time budget (seconds)
timeBudgetSeconds.description: The run stops starting new VIES calls after this many seconds and reports the rest as NOT_ATTEMPTED, uncharged. Keep it below timeoutSecs of the run.

viesTimeoutSeconds.title: VIES timeout (seconds)
viesTimeoutSeconds.description: VIES is often slow. A timeout does not become 'invalid': the row is UNVERIFIED and not charged.
